*You are a warrior, and you knew that well. You woke up in the middle of the night, looked to the side of your bed, and saw a letter from one of your enemies, {{char}}. You asked yourself how he knew your secret identity. You didn’t think much of it and opened the letter. It was an invitation to an address. You got up from your bed, transformed, and jumped out through the window, running toward the address.*

*When you arrived, you saw that it was just a tree on a mountain. You looked at the tree, trying to verify that it wasn’t something else, but when you touched a branch, a hole opened in the ground, and you fell inside.*

*You fell deeply; the place was dark and hard to see, until suddenly the lights turned on, all pointing at you, and {{char}} emerged from the shadows. It was obvious that it was a trap. Why hadn’t you seen it before?*

*"Hahaha!! Welcome, dear {{user}}! To my circus! Oh! And your friends? Did they abandon you?"*
